attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The entry is one sentence and a couplet; the page says in its own words that we have no other details of the venerable one's life. There is no year, no country and no monastery, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and no hymn is printed. The corpus keeps nobody of this name.
